Why small scripts win

By Sam Writer

Small scripts are easy to read, easy to test and easy to throw away when they stop being useful. A script that does one thing well can be understood in a single sitting.

Three habits

  • Name things plainly
  • Print what you did
  • Keep a dry-run mode

Start with the smallest version that solves your problem and grow from there.
